description: A stimulator system has been surgically implanted alongside your adrenal glands, allowing you to trigger your body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.
A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert you.  This is very useful during sleep, or if you suspect a cloaked pursuer.
In a cruel twist of fate, a poorly executed CBM surgery has given you a pair of useless bionics which make squeaking noises when you walk.
An upgrade for bionic eyes which allows the user to browse media files without needing a screen.

Frames along your cheekbones and eyesockets can, at a moment's notice, deploy protective lenses which seal your eyes behind polarized ballistic glass, providing protection from glare, bright flashes, physical attacks, and even environmental sources.
Largely subdermal, your skull is protected by titanium plates that provide a modicum of protection against all sorts of trauma.

Your abdominal and thoracic cavities are internally padded with thin pockets of a biocompatible gel that hardens on impact to protect your spine and organs.  While this doesn't prevent superficial injury, it should make you a bit tougher overall, at least as far as your torso is concerned.
//: Should conflict with anything that dramatically alters the torso's shape/internal anatomy or stuffs it full of something else.

description: You have a battery draining attachment, and thus can make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.  Use bionic menu to drain charge from a battery.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

A deadly half-meter blade is concealed within your forearm, capable of being extended through the back of your wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent you from holding anything else while extended.
The bones in your forearm have been replaced with a 12 gauge shotgun that can pop out on command.
An additional layer of tinting for the protective lenses CBM which can make the lenses dark enough to effectively blind the user when active.
Small sensors have been surgically implanted around your kidneys, allowing you to analyze your blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.

A filtration system near your liver allows you to actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs.  It will have limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in your system will be affected.
You have a complex port surgically mounted above your hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a power source via jumper cable.

Lying just beneath your skin is a thin armor made of carbon nanotubes.  This has no impact on blunt trauma but offers a small amount of protection against cutting, stabbing, and even ballistic damage.

Your body is equipped with a chain lightning generator, allowing you to emit a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake, jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.
Throughout your body lies a network of thermal piping, which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures when activated.
This high-power system uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make you blend into your background, rendering you fully invisible to normal vision.  However, you may be detected by infrared, sonar, etc.

Your nervous system is wired to a combat controller program pre-loaded with its own melee protocols.  While active, your actions in melee combat will be guided by the implant, which has above-average skill and its own martial art style, but you will not learn from this experience.

A combination of poor surgical installation and unpleasant scarring has lead to the malfunctioning bionic catastrophe you call your face.  People who mind that you look like a dime-store Frankenstein will react poorly to your appearance.
An bionic device which has shorted out and broken.  It isn't doing anything harmful, but takes up valuable space that might otherwise be used for power storage units.
Implanted nerve stimulators grant you a +2 bonus to dexterity while this bionic is active, but a -1 penalty when it is not.

You have been outfitted with three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines.  Not only can you extract much more nutrition from food, but you are highly resistant to foodborne illness, and can sometimes eat rotten food.
cant_remove_reason: The CBM has replaced the patient's digestive organs and cannot be removed.

description: A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges acid into your muscles, causing sharp pain and minor damage.
A malfunctioning bionic which occasionally discharges electricity through your body, causing pain and brief paralysis but no damage.
A malfunctioning bionic.  It doesn't perform any useful function, but will occasionally draw power from your batteries.

When this bionic is active, your hearing will be drastically improved, allowing you to hear over three times better than the average person, even if you were previously deaf or hard of hearing.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage your hearing.  When it is unpowered, you will be unable to hear at all.
//: BATEARS is better than this bionic, even if you combine the bionic with any existing hearing mutation.

description: Surgically mounted in your left arm and the palm of your left hand are small parabolic EMP field generators.  You may use power to fire a wide but short-ranged blast that will disable electronics and robots.
This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which slowly trickles directly into your blood stream.  It may fail in very dry environments.
A microcomputer wired to the thalamus that assists the brain in sorting and prioritizing sensory input.  It grants +2 perception when active, but -1 when not.
cant_remove_reason: The bionic is now critical to the continued functionality of the user's brain.

description: The eyes have been entirely replaced by a pair of implanted cameras which provide clear, high-resolution vision and come with a built-in zoom that allows the user to see long distances and treat all ranged weapons as though they had a scope.  If unpowered, the user will be completely blind.
cant_remove_reason: This bionic has completely replaced the patient's eyes.  Removing it would cause blindness.

description: Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, you are capable of altering your facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.
Throughout your body lies a network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors which can be charged with bionic power to temporarily protect you from external electrical discharge.

One of your fingers has an electrohack surgically embedded in it; an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like (but not computers).  Skill in computers is important, and a failed use may damage your circuits.
A module implanted in your body measures your calorie intake and expenditure at all times.

Light emitting diodes surgically integrated into your skin can release a flash comparable to a flashbang grenade, blinding nearby enemies.  Speakers integrated into your body mimic the loud sound, deafening those nearby.
Surgically mounted between your eyes is a small but powerful LED flashlight.
You can greatly intensify the power of your bionic flashlight to be much brighter at a much higher power cost.

A small LED display just beneath your dermal layer can be illuminated on command to show patterns of your choice at dim or bright luminosity.  It doesn't provide enough light to comfortably read or craft, but it can suffice if you have nothing else.

You don't think that capacitor is *meant* to glow, but it does, and usually at bad times.  A malfunctioning bionic randomly turns on and off, causing you to glow and making you visible in the dark without improving how much you can see in the slightest.

Tiny sensors implanted in your body are able to detect acute radiation syndrome through a gamma-H2AX assay, cross-checking blood cell counts to rapidly inform you of the severity of your exposure.  A separate sensor also scans your immediate environment to alert you to the presence of ionizing radiation.
Your feet are equipped with precision sonar equipment, allowing you to detect the movements of creatures below the ground, buried traps, and unstable terrain.

descriptions.text: You sense some creature moving underground here.

description: While activated, your muscles will be greatly enhanced, increasing your strength by 20.
Your range of vision extends into the infrared, allowing you to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark or through smoke.
Your brain has been enhanced with bionic coprocessors, giving you a +2 bonus to intelligence when this implant is active, and a -1 penalty when it is not.
cant_remove_reason: The bionic is now critical to the continued functionality of the user's brain.

description: A bionic of some sort, so badly installed that you cannot even tell what it was originally supposed to be.  Sometimes it itches horribly.
One of your fingers has a small high-powered laser surgically embedded in it.  This long range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.

This botched piece of bionic hardware slowly leaks electrolytic compounds, piezoelectric nanomaterials, and other high-tech contaminants into your bloodstream.  Needless to say, this is not good for your health.

You are equipped with bionic stimulators which augment your haematopoiesis system, allowing you to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is supposed to run continuously and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.
The index finger of your left hand has a fire starter that can extend from the tip.

One of your fingers has an electronic lockpick surgically embedded in it.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.

Surgically embedded in your left arm is a powerful electromagnet, allowing you to use your own strength to pull all nearby magnetic objects towards you.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.

A device implanted in your brain is capable of boosting your memory and learning via predictive recall, creating lasting associations before your synapses have formed connections.  This helps you learn more quickly while it's active, but it's harder to concentrate when it's unpowered.
cant_remove_reason: Removing this CBM would cause severe amnesia and neurological issues.

description: Your digestive system and power supply are interconnected; bionic energy is replenished by burning calories.  Can be toggled on and off at will.

A multitude of scientific instruments and sensors collect environmental data.  The data is compiled and presented as a simple readout of the current weather.  It also passively tells you the local air temperature.

Inside your body is a fleet of tiny dormant robots.  While activated they will flit about your body, slowly repairing damage stopping bleeding at the cost of extra power and stored calories.  Excessive use of this CBM can depress the immune system.  No power is consumed if there is nothing to heal.
When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 2 tile radius through destructive interference.
When active, this bionic will amplify existing light, allowing you to see in the dark.
A malfunctioning bionic.  It will occasionally emit a loud burst of noise.
You're really not sure how the CBM ended up in your nose, but no matter how it got there this badly misplaced bionic makes it difficult to breathe.  Increases mouth encumbrance by ten.
While powered, these implants will shock attackers in melee who attack unarmed or with conductive weapons.
Your nervous system is wired to allow you to inhibit the signals of pain, allowing you to dull your senses at will.  However, the use of this system may cause delayed reaction time and drowsiness.
Due to a badly misplaced dielectric stylette, you are now suffering from mild optic neuropathy.  Increases eye encumbrance by ten.

A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 100 kJ.  Having at least one of these is a prerequisite to using powered bionics.  You will also need a power supply, found in various CBMs.
A Compact Bionics Module that increases your power capacity by 250 kJ.
Damaged power circuits cause short-circuiting inside your muscles when your batteries are above 75% capacity, causing greatly reduced strength.  This has no effect if you have no internal batteries.

Increases your body's wavelength, allowing you to quantum tunnel through walls, reappearing on the other side.  Power drain in standby is minimal, but each tile tunneled through costs 250 bionic power.

An advanced system of filters have been surgically implanted throughout your airway.  They provide minor protection from smoke and irritants even while unpowered, and when powered will filter out most all harmful airborne compounds.
A compact communications device has been built into your ears, enabling you to communicate over radio waves.
A system of advanced piezomechanical blood filters have been surgically implanted throughout your body, allowing you to purge yourself of absorbed radiation at the cost of some bionic power.

You possess razor-sharp claws underneath your nails which can be deployed by flexing your fingers.  While active, they can be used in combat as long as you are unarmed and your fingers are not covered.
Your urinary tract is fitted with filters and reservoirs that allow your body to reclaim water from metabolic waste while this device is powered, greatly reducing your need to hydrate.
A small module connected to your brain allows you to interface with nearby devices with wireless capabilities.
Your entire body may resonate at very high power, creating a short-range shockwave.  While it will not do much damage to creatures, solid objects such as walls and doors will be damaged.
While this system is powered, your body will produce very little odor, making it nearly impossible for creatures to track you by scent.
A poorly-wired bionic which fails to serve its intended purpose, this malfunctioning device periodically short-circuits, causing systemic muscle tremors.

An electromagnetic stimulator has been surgically implanted on the back of your head and along your spine, continually draining power.  As long as it's active, you will not suffer from sleep deprivation, although you may still feel sleepy; and if you're sleep deprived already, it will gradually reduce the symptoms of lacking sleep.

While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock your opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.

You generate a powerful shockwave, knocking back all nearby creatures.  Targets are stunned briefly, take damage and additional stun upon impact with impassable terrain, and knockback any creatures they collide with.

Through a combination of psychochemical manipulation and old fashioned electrical nerve stimulation, this malfunctioning bionic alters your brain chemistry in such a way as to cause fatigue.  You will find yourself tiring a bit faster than before.

One piezoelectric solenoid surgically installed backwards, two crossed wires, and four burned-out capacitors later you started falling on your face and writhing around at the least convenient times.  This incorrectly-configured bionic periodically stuns you for a short duration.
Your nervous system has been enhanced with bionic stimulators, giving you a 10% boost to your speed.
Improperly installed wires cause a physical stiffness in most of your body, causing increased encumbrance.
Your muscules have been surgically enhanced with synthetic myomer fibers, giving you a +2 bonus to strength when this implant is active and a -1 penalty when it is not.

A system of surgical grade scalpels is implanted in your forearms, extending from just above your wrists.  They allow you to make automated precise cuts and can also be used as a high-quality butchering tool.
You have highly efficient artificial lungs which greatly increase your oxygen intake.  If they are not powered you will suffocate, and they weaken your immune system somewhat.
cant_remove_reason: The CBM has replaced the patient's lungs and cannot be removed.

description: While active, this bionic provides a visual HUD synced to sensors in your hands that greatly aid in targeting ranged weapons.
While active, a tiny device in your inner ear periodically generates ultrasonic pulses which aid in navigation, provided you are underwater and able to hear.
You have a powerful stun gun built into your hand.  Activate to attempt to zap an adjacent enemy.

This highly experimental unit folds space over short distances, instantly transporting your body up to 25 feet at the cost of much power.  Note that prolonged or frequent use may have dangerous side effects.

Self-locking thumbs hold tight (even when you really don't want them to) and don't let go (even when you'd rather they did).  Increases hand encumbrance by ten, while failing to improve your ability to hold objects whatsoever.

At the cost of all stored bionic power, you may increase your body speed and reactions dramatically, essentially freezing time.  You are still delicate, however, and violent or rapid movements may damage you due to friction.
Surgically implanted in your hands and forearms is a set of compact tools and a welder that runs off your internal power banks.

Your fingers and arms have been implanted with retractable electrical probes connected to a multimeter embedded in your arm, allowing you to measure electrical voltage, resistance, and current by touch.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.

Your fingers and arms have been implanted a soldering iron, a multimeter, and a set of small screwdrivers, providing all the tools required for working with bench-scale electrical circuits.  This also provides your hands and arms with a modicum of protection against electric shocks.

Your joints have been surgically equipped with torsion ratchets that slowly generate power when you move.  Whilst this is toggled, moving will require more effort, though more power will be generated.

Your leg joints have been equipped with servomotors that provide power-assisted movement.  Movement takes less effort when this bionic is online.  However, when it's offline it will hamper your movement, as you struggle against its moving parts.
A malfunctioning bionic which causes occasional visual distortion and pixelation.
Your nervous system has been augmented with bionic processors, allowing you to dodge attacks beyond normal human capability.
You have a port that allows devices which can use a power bank to draw directly from your bionic power supply.
Rather than vocal cords, you speak through an electronic system which gives you what can best be described as a "creepy robot voice."
//: bird mutants might have an entirely different vocal chord structure rather than just a different tone of voice

description: You have been equipped with an internal atomic clock, ensuring that you will always know the current time.  Additionally, it includes a silent alarm clock function.

Nanotubes surgically embedded in the palm of your hand will pump any available fluid out of a dead body, cleanse it of impurities and convert it into drinkable water.  You must, however, have a container to store the water in.

The flesh of the inside of your middle finger has been replaced with a tube leading into your arteries, with a retractable needle extending out of the tip of the finger when clenched.  This lets you pump intravenous drugs like morphine directly into your bloodstream without needing to carry a syringe.

Titanium bracing has been installed onto your elbows, knees, and spine, making them far better at handling strain.  Your carrying capacity is increased by 20 kilograms, or about 44 pounds, and you receive slightly less bashing damage to your arms, legs and torso.

A set of highly sensitive sensors is installed in your mouth, and a small yet sophisticated analyzer is installed in the cavity of your skull.  The active bionic will nullify the taste of all comestibles with negative enjoyment value at the cost of draining bionic power.
A broken implant that sends electromagnetic impulses that reduce other implants capacity to store charge.
A malfunctioning bionic attached to your digestive system causes intermittent nausea, making it difficult to keep food down.
This damaged CBM occasionally leaks radiation.
Reactive shock absorbers installed in your wrists and elbows which greatly reduce felt recoil.

A set of miniscule devices are embedded in your brain stem and hypothalamus.  When active, they allow the user to fall asleep almost instantly and at-will.  The downside, however, is that the user will remain asleep no matter what happens to their body until they complete their natural sleep cycle, unless a sleep alarm from a differet bionic device is triggered.

An implant that works on simple physics rather than electronics, this CBM replaces the ulnar collateral ligaments with assistive biocompatible tethers that automatically constrict and relax to improve the user's throwing distance and accuracy.
A powerful electromagnetic system housed in the palms which, when powered up, will expend power to greatly increasing the force of thrown magnetic objects.
